ios.desc:
Get accurate hourly and 15-day weather forecasts from two independent weather providers, with high-resolution Doppler and predictive weather radar, lightning tracking, severe weather alerts, real-time barometer, tide predictions, air quality, storm and hurricane tracks, and a unique animated Weather Clock.

eWeather HD puts detailed weather information in one beautiful place. Check temperature, rain, snow, wind, UV index, pressure trends, NOAA buoy data and Apple Watch complications — and plan your day with confidence.

Key features:

• Accurate hourly and 15-day weather forecasts for local and worldwide locations
• Two independent weather providers — choose the weather data that works best for your location
• High-resolution Doppler and predictive weather radar for the Americas, including rain and snow
• Lightning tracker with interactive weather maps
• Severe weather alerts and warnings for the U.S. and Europe via PUSH notifications
• Global storm, hurricane, typhoon and cyclone tracks with projected paths
• Live temperature badge and four Home Screen widgets, including the animated Weather Clock and Barometer
• Real-time barometer using the iPhone or iPad pressure sensor
• Barometric pressure trends and PUSH alerts for pressure changes associated with migraines
• Tide predictions, high and low tide times, tide charts and NOAA ocean buoy data from 700+ buoys
• Air quality index, air pollution details, maps and forecasts
• UV index, humidity, dew point, feels-like temperature and geomagnetic activity
• Animated satellite cloud cover for the U.S., Europe and Asia
• Interactive animated weather and wind maps with eight layers
• 10 years of historical weather and climate data, including sea surface temperatures
• Sun and moon times, moon phases and astronomical events including eclipses, equinoxes and solstices
• Siri Shortcuts, Spotlight search and iMessage app
• Apple Watch weather app with eight complications

WHY EWEATHER HD?

The unique Weather Clock lets you see hour-by-hour weather conditions at a glance, so you can tell when rain or snow is expected to start.

With two independent weather providers, you can compare forecast data and choose the information you trust for your location.

Advanced weather radar, lightning tracking and severe weather alerts help you stay informed about potentially dangerous conditions, including thunderstorms, hail, tornadoes, hurricanes and flooding.

quotes.text:
There's an app that'll show you the temperature in realtime on the icon without the need to open the app. It's called eWeather HD and uses the notifications feature of iOS in a pretty clever way. The app itself is a little obtuse, but having the temperature right there has made it worthwhile to me.
